property_summary: For any call to transfer, the reference contract always accepts (does not revert) when _tos.length == 1 whereas the mutant rejects (reverts) for some inputs with exactly one recipient; thus: for all inputs with a single recipient, reference returns true (call succeeds) but the mutant may revert.
change_summary: Change the require that checks _tos.length > 0 to require _tos.length > 1 so calls with exactly one recipient return differently.
